text: Measure quadratic growth by counting, and check the count against the closed form. Fill in the three blanks.
choices: for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int ___; j < n; j++) ___;
n, count, ___, prev == 0 ? "-" : String.format("%.2f", count / (double) prev));
explanation: Verified: 499,500 then 1,999,000 then 7,998,000, with the ratio exactly 4.00 each time and the formula matching. Four per doubling is the signature of quadratic growth, and the `1/2` in the formula does not affect the ratio — which is the first concrete hint of why big-O discards constant factors.
